tools.name: kairos_wallet_activity
tools.description: Wallet balances and activity on Base: EOA, EIP-7702 delegated EOA or contract, ETH balance, nonce, proxy implementation (EIP-1967, legacy OpenZeppelin, EIP-1822, EIP-1167), balances of 10 major Base tokens and USDC/WETH transfers in and out over the last 24 h (counts, amounts, latest transfer; marke

tools.name: kairos_contract_check
tools.description: Contract check on Base: bytecode size, Sourcify verification, proxy detection (EIP-1967 incl. beacon, legacy OpenZeppelin, EIP-1822, EIP-1167 clones) with the implementation's verification, EIP-7702 delegated EOAs, and a neutral analysis. Reports what was or was not detected; never claims code canno

tools.name: kairos_page_markdown
tools.description: Web page, PDF or text file to clean Markdown: main content kept (headings, lists, links, tables, code), navigation and ads removed, links made absolute; PDFs as text with page count. JavaScript-only pages are refused, not charged. Honours robots.txt, refuses private addresses; limits 2 MB HTML, 8 MB

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "kairos_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "FREE. Lists the paid research products (id, HTTP route, USD price, description), the seller's pay-to address and network, prepaid credit packs, and how to pay. Call this first." → after: "Free. Lists the research products with prices, routes and the free-tier quotas, the seller's pay-to address and network, and the prepaid credit packs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
